RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the December 11, 2003/Agrahayana 20, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Development of North Eastern Region;
Disinvestment; External Affairs; Labour; Planning; Road
Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries; Space;
Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions—20

NSESSION\3702RSQLE 44
Working Group on Minimum Wages
*141. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH:
SHRI ABANI ROY:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Working Group on
Minimum Wages (WGMW) has
recommended minimum wage of Rs. 66/-
per day to the labourer;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof;
and
(c) whether Government have received
complaints regarding non-payment of wages
at Government prescribed rates from various
quarters, and if so, what steps Government
propose to take to ensure the payment of
minimum wage of Rs. 66/- per day to the
labourer?
Regional Passport Office, Bangalore
*142. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  the number of passport applications/
renewal applications received by the
Regional Passport Office, Bangalore, from
January, 2002 to the end of October, 2003;
(b) the average time taken to issue a
passport; and
(c) the steps taken to help the people
outside Bangalore to get the passports?
Splitting of IOC
*143. SHRI DIPANKAR MUKHER-
JEE: Will the Minister of DISINVEST-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to consider splitting of Indian Oil Corpo-
ration and selling its marketing arm; and
(b) if so, the reason therefor in view of
(i) Government's earlier decision of keeping
IOC as a flagship company under Public
Sector, and (ii) unviability of stand-alone
refineries?
Legislation on minimum wages
*144. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating a legislation providing for

minimum wages for workers in the
unorganised sectors including rag-pickers
and rickshaw pullers;
(b) the rationale behind leaving out
domestic workers from the ambit of this
proposed legislation; and
(c)  whether the trade unions have
expressed reservations over the legislation
for lack of implementing mechanism and
the fact that it requires contributions from
beneficiaries?
Pension and insurance benefits for
unorganised sector
*145. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of LABOUR be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to
introduce pension and insurance benefits for
the unorganized sector;
(b) if so, the details of the sectors that
would be covered by this scheme;
(c) whether the self-employed persons
would also be covered by this programme;
and
(d) how many women workers would
be covered by this programme?
Rail link between India and
ASEAN countries
*146. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the progress in the proposed rail
link between India, Myanmar, Thailand and
Vietnam; and
(b) the reaction and contribution of these
four countries to this proposal?
Non-core sectors under Contract
Labour Act
*147. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
thirteen non-core sectors to be brought
under the Contract Labour Act;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
rename the Contract Labour (Regulation and
Abolition) Act; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Pace of computer revolution
†*148. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the pace of
computer revolution that was there in the
country sometime back has come to a halt
now;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
due to the crowd on the net, the working on
internet is becoming difficult day-by-day;
(c) whether it is also a fact that all the
internet service providers are charging
arbitrarily; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
New prices of wheat and rice
*149. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have announced new prices for wheat and
rice at which exporters can lift from the
central pool; and

(b) if so, the new prices and the stock
of wheat and rice with Government?
Second phase of the NHDP

SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA:
Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government have
approved the second phase of the Prime
Minister's National Highway Development
Project comprising of 7,300 km. o

Total number of questions—155

NSESSION\3702RSQLE 204
Funds under PMRY
937. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds released to
Madhya Pradesh under PMRY during the
last three years;
(b) the number of the villages benefited
as a result thereof; and
(c) the funds proposed during the year
2003-04?
Targets under PMRY
938. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) what were the annual targets fixed
for Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu under
PMRY during the last four years, year-
wise;
(b) whether the targets were achieved
in both the States during the said period;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) what remedial measures Government
have taken in this regard?
Foreign market for Khadi products
939. PROF. M. SANKARALINGAM:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
taken steps to create a market for superior
Khadi products in neighbouring countries
like Sri Lanka, Pakistan and other SAARC
countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the efforts made by Government to
familiarise Khadi in the country during the
past four years?
Transfer of Group 'D' employees
of Atomic Energy Education
Society of Hyderabad
940. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether class IV (Group D)
employees of Atomic Energy Education

205
WIN2/NSESSION\3703RS 205
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi
Society working at Hyderabad were
transferred to Bihar and Mumbai on the
grounds of work shrinkage;
(b) if so, whether Atomic Energy
Education Society passed an order stating
"all the Group 'D' employees should be
placed at the service of nuclear Fuel
complex, Hyderabad and they would be
paid by the Atomic Energy Society";
(c) if so, the reasons and circumstances
leading to violation of the above orders;
and
(d) the reasons for not issuing orders to
N.F.C. Hyderabad, to absorb the surplus
AEES Group 'D' instead of recruiting from
outside?
Safety measures in nuclear plants
†941. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that adequate
safety measures are not available in most
of the nuclear plants in the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that radiation
related accidents have become a frequent
phenomenon in all the nuclear plants; and
(c) if so, the details of such accidents
during the last five years, plant-wise and
year-wise?
Additional spectrum for telecom
service providers
942. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state the details of the
modalities to make 25 Mhz additional
spectrum for telecom service providers
over the next three years with the cost of
the service?
WLL and fixed line licenses
943. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the companies which have applied
for WLL and fixed line licenses during the
last one year;
(b) how much performance bank
guarantee and entry fee have been
deposited by these companies with
Government, company-wise; and
(c) whether these companies are likely
to offer new services to the customers and
if so, the details thereof, company-wise?
Escort service
944. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to start an 'Escort Service' which
would provide information on foreign
countries visa rules, etc. to IT professionals
working abroad; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Waiting list of telephone
connections in Orissa
945. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of people waiting for
telephone connections in each district in
Orissa;
(b) the steps taken to clear the waiting
list; and

206
WIN2/NSESSION\3703RS 206
(c) by when, telephone would be
sanctioned in each district on demand?
Telephone Adalats
946. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Telephone Adalats
organized in each districts of Assam during
the last three years; and
(b) the number of cases referred to these
Adalats and disposed of during this period,
district-wise?
Mobile services
